pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. At a wedding, we are most likely to hear (1 mark)
   A. work songs only
   B. marriage songs
   C. funeral songs
   D. topical songs only

2. What is the first command at the start of a race? (1 mark)
   A. Stop
   B. Set
   C. Go
   D. On your marks

3. In a side roll, you should keep your legs (1 mark)
   A. together with toes pointed
   B. lifted off the mat
   C. bent
   D. wide apart

4. At the start of the side roll, your arms are (1 mark)
   A. behind your back
   B. folded on your chest
   C. stretched above your head
   D. on your knees

5. To improvise a rhythmic pattern means to (1 mark)
   A. stay silent
   B. make it up on the spot
   C. copy it from a book only
   D. write it before playing

6. Which facial expression fits a joyful song? (1 mark)
   A. Closed eyes
   B. A smile
   C. A frown
   D. A yawn

7. Which is used only for taking photographs? (1 mark)
   A. Digital camera
   B. Whistle
   C. Radio
   D. Torch

8. A sign that gets wider to the right means (1 mark)
   A. slow
   B. stop
   C. getting softer
   D. getting louder

9. Which of these makes a photograph too dark? (1 mark)
   A. A battery
   B. Too much practice
   C. A clean lens
   D. Too little light

10. In a medium start, the rear knee is level with (1 mark)
   A. the middle of the front foot
   B. the start line
   C. the toe of the back foot
   D. the heel of the front foot

11. What is the last part of the sequence in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Jumping
   B. Getting up slowly and standing tall
   C. Rolling backwards
   D. Running away

12. In a folk song, the chorus (1 mark)
   A. answers and repeats
   B. hides
   C. paints
   D. conducts the umpire

13. A darker tone of a colour is called a (1 mark)
   A. secondary
   B. tint
   C. shade
   D. frame

14. Which shows neatness in a montage? (1 mark)
   A. Torn edges
   B. Clean cut edges and no glue marks
   C. Glue everywhere
   D. Loose pieces

15. How many rectangular slabs of different sizes are cut in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Ten
   C. One
   D. Three

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three reasons for flying the Kenyan flag at an athletics event. (3 marks)

17. Why should we enter the water feet first? (2 marks)

18. Describe how to do the frog jump. (3 marks)

19. State two ways of playing percussion instruments. (2 marks)

20. How should you receive feedback from others? (3 marks)

21. Give the French rhythm names for a crotchet and a pair of quavers. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — marriage songs
   Marriage songs praise the couple and give good wishes.

2. D — On your marks
   The starter first says on your marks.

3. A — together with toes pointed
   Legs stay together to keep the log shape.

4. C — stretched above your head
   Arms overhead with palms together keep the body long.

5. B — make it up on the spot
   Improvising is inventing a pattern without preparing it first.

6. B — A smile
   Facial expressions show the mood.

7. A — Digital camera
   A digital camera is made for photography.

8. D — getting louder
   An opening sign means the music grows louder.

9. D — Too little light
   Poor light makes dark pictures.

10. A — the middle of the front foot
   The medium start places the rear knee by the middle of the front foot.

11. B — Getting up slowly and standing tall
   Finish by standing up slowly with control.

12. A — answers and repeats
   The chorus responds to the soloist.

13. C — shade
   Adding black makes a shade.

14. B — Clean cut edges and no glue marks
   Neatness means careful cutting and pasting.

15. D — Three
   Three slabs are cut, one for each of d, r and m.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows which country the athletes represent; it builds pride and patriotism; it brings people together to cheer; it shows respect to visitors. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is safer because you cannot hit your head on the bottom, and you can see where you land.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Squat with hands on the ground. Spring forward with the legs. Land softly on toes and hands with bent knees.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Striking and shaking. Scraping is also correct.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen quietly, do not argue, say thank you and think about the ideas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Crotchet: taa. Pair of quavers: ta-te.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
